svg.title: The three goals of neat-os
svg.desc: Three goals and 13 principles. Kaizen, improve from shipped work (4): Encode lessons; Smallest complete change; Propose, never promote; Keep the guide true. Determinism, same inputs, trusted results (7): Evidence before done; Never invent facts; Inspect before inventing; Red is a stop; Use the declared runtime; Enqueue side effects; Never store secrets. Parallelism, independent workers at once (2): Keep human gates; Surface conflicts.
